author: trivuh
quote: 1 point for the graphics. Other than that, this game is incredibly underwhelming. Everyone wanted this to be great, I wanted it to be great. The story is boring, the characters are boring, Jason himself is a completely soulless persona. Lucia is insufferable and the whole story centers around you being a good boy to her. Genuinely unlikable characters. There is no freedom in this game, everything is linear. This is an HR version of GTA. Turns out nothing works since Dan's and Lazlow's departure from Rockstar.
